title: Watch evening light at White Sands

location.label: White Sands National Park, New Mexico

description: Drive into White Sands and walk a manageable stretch of the Interdune Boardwalk before sunset. The gypsum dunes begin almost white, then take on cooler blue, pink, and lavender tones as the light falls. Stay close to a known route and notice how the mountains and shadows give shape to a place that can first seem endless.
teaser: Watch white gypsum dunes change color at dusk.
goodToKnow: Before you go, confirm park hours, road access and any temporary closures; keep walking optional.
whyItMightDelightYou: The quiet pleasure is seeing a simple landscape transform without anything moving but the light.
